summary.text: Cecil Bell Jr. is a member of the Texas House of Representatives. His official biography, which refers to his fifth session, describes him as vice chair of the House Appropriations Committee for Articles VI, VII and VIII and chair of an Appropriations subcommittee on strategic fiscal review and federal relief funds.

paragraphs.text: Bell is a sixth-generation Texan born in Rosenberg; his official biography describes him as CEO of nine active enterprises with cow/calf ranching operations in Leon and Freestone Counties.
He was chairman of the Greater Magnolia Economic Development Partnership and president of the Magnolia ISD school board.

His biography also lists a seat on the House Committee on International Relations and Economic Development and says he authored legislation on landfill permitting and property owners' rights in eminent domain proceedings.
He and his wife, Jo Ann, moved to Magnolia in 1993, have two sons, and attend Magnolia Church of Christ.
